about.intro: I build reliable, maintainable web applications and care about clean architecture, practical trade-offs, and code that another engineer can pick up without friction.

projects.intro: A curated list of projects I've built and experimented with over the years. While there's a long queue of works-in-progress behind the scenes, I'm looking forward to wrapping them up and adding them here soon.

items.megaparts: Megaparts.bg is one of the leading online platforms in Bulgaria for new and secondhand automotive spare parts. The website offers a vast, well-categorized inventory of parts sourced from disassembled vehicles, catering to car owners and mechanics looking for affordable repair solutions with reliable delivery.
items.megabitak: Megabitak.bg is a popular Bulgarian online classifieds platform and marketplace. It connects buyers and sellers nationwide, allowing users to publish free ads for a wide variety of new and secondhand automotive spare parts.
items.acceleratedAnswers: Accelerated Answers is Kantar Profiles' agile, do-it-together (D-I-T) and do-it-yourself (DIY) survey solution for custom market research. The platform enables businesses and marketers to build custom templates, launch quick-polling surveys across global markets, and access dynamic, AI-assisted reporting.
items.uvel: Uvel.bg is an established e-commerce platform specializing in high-quality jewelry, luxury accessories, and stylish timepieces from renowned brands.
items.kartichkaQr: Greeting card generator supporting custom fonts, templates, and audio recording.
